resources.string: MayaXDev advanced telephony hook to program internal SIM MSISDN subscriber number
High-performance Android systems engineering & integrity tooling.
Telephony stack cycled. Ready to bind.

KAISE SETUP KAREIN (STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE):

Step 1 — LSPosed Scope Selection:
• LSPosed Manager app kholiye.
• Modules tab me jaakar SIM Number Setter Pro par tap karein.
• Module ko Enable karein aur Scope me:
  ✔ Phone (com.android.phone)
  ✔ System Framework (android)
select karein.

Step 2 — Auto-Restart Telephony (Bina Phone Reboot Ke):
• Upar diye gaye \"⚡ Auto-Restart Telephony Stack\" button par tap karein.
• Ye root shell se com.android.phone ko restart karega aur LSPosed hook turant attach ho jayega.

Step 3 — SIM Number Write Karein:
• Agar Dual SIM hai toh SIM 1 ya SIM 2 choose karein.
• Apna mobile number international format me enter karein (Jaise: +919876543210).
• \"SAVE NUMBER TO SIM\" par tap karein.
• Ye number permanent SIM card ke internal hardware record (EF_MSISDN) me write ho jata hai.

Step 4 — UPI Apps & Settings Verification:
• Phone Settings > About Phone > Status > SIM Status me check karein, aapka number dikhega.
• Paytm / PhonePe / GPay open karein — number turant verify hoga aur \"Unknown SIM\" error khatam ho jayega!
